Description
Rand Refinery is one of the world’s leading refiners and smelters of gold bullion products. The
1 oz rand refinery gold bar
is the newly introduced gold bar into the precious metals market by the Rand Refinery located in South Africa. These rand refinery 1 oz gold bars were previously only available in gram denominations. However, the Rand Refinery has also introduced gold bars in 1-ounce denominations.
Owning Rand Refinery
gold bars
is a great way for investors to diversify their precious metals portfolio with a recognized brand name that boasts ethically sourcing its gold. Rand refinery
1 oz gold bar
is made from 1 troy oz of .9999 fine gold and comes in a sealed black assay card that certifies the item’s purity, weight, and gold content.
Design of  1 oz Rand Refinery Gold Bar(New w/ Assay)
The obverse of the 1 oz South Africa Gold Bar features the Rand Refinery name and emblem at the top of the gold bar. The rand refinery gold bars’ metal type and purity are located beneath the, followed by the words “1 oz Pure Gold”. The unique serial number for each South Africa gold bar is inscribed at the bottom. These serial number codes start with an alphabet RR followed by a six-digit numeric code.
The reverse side of 1 oz Gold Rand Refinery features a repeating horizontal pattern of a parent elephant leading an elephant calf holding onto its tail with another parent walking behind them. The elephant inscribed on the gold bar is “
Loxodonta
” which is the genus of the African elephant.
Main Highlights of Rand Refinery 1 oz Gold Bar
Contains 10 troy oz of .9999 fine Gold.
Produced by the Rand Refinery
Each Rand Refinery Gold bar comes with its own assay card for authentication.
Eligible for Precious Metal IRAs.
Features the depiction of the refinery’s logo and specifications on the obverse.
Features the depiction of a repeating horizontal pattern of a parent elephant leading an elephant calf holding onto its tail with another parent walking behind them on the reverse.
Each South Africa gold bar is assigned a unique serial number.
